sig-etablissements.note: Trimmed projection, a key whitelist rather than a single drop. Kept: the top-level type, totalFeatures and features; per feature its type, geometry, geometry_name and the whole properties object as received. Dropped: GeoServer's per-request feature id (it changes on every pull) and any other top-level key the endpoint may add, crs included. Features are sorted by the stable properties.id, with their own canonical body as the tie-break.
